question: Should ClawHub adopt the compatibility-preserving no-case-collision package rule from the linked PR, including PROTOCOL.md, or choose a narrower casing policy?
rationale: Current main explicitly supports lowercase and legacy readme aliases, while the requested enforcement changes the published skill package contract and may require docs/spec and content cleanup decisions.

options.title: Adopt the linked collision rule
options.body: Keep lowercase and legacy readme compatibility, reject case-colliding package files across ingestion paths, document the rule, and close this issue after the linked PR merges.

options.title: Narrow the rule to skill readmes
options.body: Reject only SKILL.md/skill.md/skills.md collisions for now and defer PROTOCOL.md until it is an explicit package contract.

options.title: Keep current compatibility
options.body: Decline the stricter validation in this repository and handle existing openclaw/skills content cleanup outside ClawHub validation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked collision rule
recommendation.body: Keep lowercase and legacy readme compatibility, reject case-colliding package files across ingestion paths, document the rule, and close this issue after the linked PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-main routing signal for the documented package contract and central alias-handling paths.
